tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: 도플리로 비공개 테스트를 진행하기 위한 필수·권장 조건 (비공개 트랙, 출시 국가 한국, minSdk, 유료 앱, TWA 미지원). / Required and recommended conditions for a closed test with Doply (closed track, South Korea as a release country, minSdk, paid apps, no TWA).

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: 도플리 서비스 개요: 테스터 수, 테스트 기간, 기기, 일일 실행 스케줄, 스크린샷, 크래시 리포트, 요금, 공식 판매처, 조직 계정 해당 여부, MCP 키 받는 곳. / Doply overview: number of testers, test period, devices, daily launch schedule, screenshots, crash reports, pricing, official sales channels, organization accounts, where to get an MCP key.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: 사람에게 직접 문의해야 할 때의 연락처 (이메일, 카카오 채널, 크몽 구매자는 크몽 채팅). / How to reach a person at Doply (email, Kakao channel, Kmong chat for Kmong buyers).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_faq" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
